global.title: Iceye's global presence expands to address sovereign demand
global.summary: Since raising more than $1 billion in a Series F funding round, Iceye has moved rapidly to address growing demand for sovereign space capabilities. In quick succession, the Finnish synthetic aperture radar satellite manufacturer and constellation operator established Iceye Germany, Iceye Portugal, Iceye India, an Iceye technology hub in the Netherlands, a strategic partnership with South Korean satellite operator KT Sat and local leadership for Iceye United Arab Emirates.
